title: Alberta abandoned well surface locations
license: Alberta Energy Regulator attributed noncommercial reproduction. This is not an official version and is not endorsed by AER.
limitations: Complete published abandoned-well layer only, not all Alberta wells. Original surface locations; revised-location layer not joined. Orphan designation unknown. Distribution file Last-Modified is retained separately from retrieval. No engineering or excavation use.

title: Ontario petroleum well records
limitations: Full published layer is not all physically existing wells. Includes salt, storage, unlocated, potential and not-drilled records; preserve WELL_TYPE and WELL_MODE. Orphan designation and reclamation completion absent. Plugging date is a source event and must not override an explicitly re-entered or active current mode. Coordinates are approximate at source-specific accuracy.

title: British Columbia well surface locations

orphanJoin.comparison: decimal integer equivalence; 00001 equals 1; absent membership remains unknown

limitations: Published surface-location view includes cancelled authorizations and un-drilled authorizations. ABNZ is zone abandonment, not completed whole-well abandonment. Operator field is abbreviation, not proof of present ownership or liability. Restoration flag is separate from closure and orphan designation. Do not treat absent orphan join as not orphan.

title: Saskatchewan designated orphan wells
publisher: Government of Saskatchewan, Ministry of Energy and Resources
license: Government of Saskatchewan Standard Unrestricted Use Data Licence v2.0
limitations: Full source-layer snapshot, not all Saskatchewan wells. The inventory retains wells with completed abandonment or reclamation and transferred records. Designated means present in this orphan-designation inventory, not necessarily still an outstanding orphan obligation. The source licensee name is not a verified present owner. Dates are supplied events, not a complete lifecycle. Extract date text is preserved without guessing its day/month convention.

definitions.orphanStatus: Designated because the well is in the ministry orphan inventory. The ministry defines an orphan as an investigated site with no legally responsible and/or financially able party for abandonment and/or reclamation. Historical completion and transfer fields must also be inspected.
definitions.closureStatus: Completed abandonment status or a supplied abandonment date maps to abandoned. Required and other states remain unknown, not active or suspended.
definitions.reclamationStatus: Source CURRENT_ORPHAN_RECLAMATION_STA is preserved separately from wellbore closure.

method: ArcGIS ID enumeration followed by 200-ID batches with outSR=4326. All enumerated source features included.

title: Manitoba petroleum well locations
limitations: Full downloadable snapshot, not real-time. Includes water, salt and potash test wells plus cancelled authorizations; raw status retained. MAP_STATUS may describe directional surface location instead of closure; use explicit STATUS. No orphan designation or reclamation fields. Public ArcGIS layer17 returned only1 record during probe and is unsuitable as full feed.
